name: The Mechanical Elephant Caravan
description: A procession of ornate mechanical elephants made of brass and copper travels across a desert of blue sand, their trunks spraying streams of golden light instead of water.
prompt: An elegant caravan of four massive mechanical elephants constructed from polished brass and copper, intricate gearwork and filigree visible in their construction, walking across a surreal desert of blue sand, their trunks spraying streams of golden liquid light instead of water, ornate howdahs decorated with gems, sunset lighting casting long shadows, highly detailed steampunk fantasy art
caption: Marching through lands where logic takes flight... 🐘⚙️ What precious cargo do these giants carry?
